# AIEP Documentation Structure

When initializing a project with `ai project init`, the following structure is generated. This is the canonical layout for AI Engineering Platform projects.

## Generated by `ai init`

```
.ai/
├── code-graph.yaml         # API endpoints and components
├── memory.yaml             # Dependency analysis
├── state.yaml              # Project state (provider, agent, status)
└── global/
    └── skills/             # Symlinked from ~/.hermes/skills/ (DO NOT commit)

docs/
├── adr/                    # Architecture Decision Records
│   └── ADR-001-tech-stack.md
├── api/                    # API documentation
├── games/                  # Game-specific rules (for game projects)
├── specs/                  # Feature specifications
│   └── SPEC-001-initial-setup.md
├── ARCHITECTURE.md         # System architecture
└── ROADMAP.md              # Development roadmap

MASTERPROMPT.md             # Project description for AI context
```

## Key Files

### MASTERPROMPT.md
Contains:
- Project description (what it does, for whom)
- Architecture overview (directories, entry points)
- Tech stack
- Development conventions

### .ai/code-graph.yaml
Lists all API endpoints and components for code navigation.

### .ai/state.yaml
```yaml
active_agent: hermes
project: <project-name>
provider: free
status: initialized
```

### docs/adr/
Architecture Decision Records follow the format:
- Title and status (Accepted/Rejected/Proposed)
- Context
- Decision
- Consequences (positive and negative)
- Alternatives considered

### docs/specs/
Feature specifications with:
- Objective
- Scope
- Functional and non-functional requirements
- Task table with status

## .gitignore for AIEP

```
# Dependencies
node_modules/
.pnpm-store/

# AI skills (symlinks, not committed)
.ai/global/skills/

# Build
dist/
build/

# Environment
.env
.env.local

# Database
*.db
*.sqlite

# Logs
*.log

# OS
.DS_Store

# Cache
.cache/
*.tsbuildinfo
```

## Notes

- `.ai/global/skills/` contains symlinks to `~/.hermes/skills/` — do not commit
- `MASTERPROMPT.md` is auto-generated and updated by `ai` commands
- `docs/adr/` and `docs/specs/` should be maintained as the project evolves
- The `.ai/` directory is for AI tooling, not for application code
